legend: Abdulrahman has OCD so he is so careful with how clean and neat his codes are, so naturally he likes implementation and data structure problem, so Ahmad decided to give him one. Please don't disappoint him with your code for this data structures problem.
You're given two arrays a%%ZSMJ0%% and b%%ZSMJ1%% of size n%%ZSMJ2%%. You're also given an integer k%%ZSMJ3%%, the value of any sequence (1≤i1<i2<…<ik≤n)%%ZSMJ4%% is ∑kj=1aij −max1≤j≤kbij%%ZSMJ5%%.
What's the maximum value of any sequence of length k%%ZSMJ6%%?
input: The first line of the input contains an integer t%%ZSMJ7%% (1≤t≤103)%%ZSMJ8%% – the number of test cases.
For each test case, the first line contains two integers n%%ZSMJ9%% k%%ZSMJ10%% (1≤k≤n≤2⋅105)%%ZSMJ11%%.
The next n%%ZSMJ12%% lines each contains two integers ai%%ZSMJ13%% bi%%ZSMJ14%% (1≤ai≤109;−1015≤bi≤1015)%%ZSMJ15%%.
It's guaranteed that the sum of n%%ZSMJ16%% over all test cases doesn't exceed 106%%ZSMJ17%%.
output: For each test case, print one integer, the maximum value of any sequence of length k.
